_implementation_note: AoE abilities use target_type 'enemy_aoe' plus max_targets, NOT an is_aoe flag. is_aoe is a Monster-ability field (entities/monster.py); combat/abilities.py's _ability_from_data never reads it for a player ability, and Ability._apply_effect decides AoE off target_type == 'enemy_aoe'. The seven is_aoe flags currently in data/abilities/guardian.json therefore do nothing, and those abilities hit one target.

abilities.name: Attack
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: Convention: every class ships a free rank-1 Attack.

abilities.name: Twin Slice
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target. Generates 20 Felfury.
abilities._source: CoA: the class-wide melee builder - Felwracked counts 'every 3rd Twin Slice or Fel Fireball', Twin Fury and Vengeance both key off it, and Tyrant lists it among the things that 'each add 1' Felfury. Rogue's sinister_strike curve, free, generating instead of costing.

abilities.name: Fel Fireball

abilities.name: Sunder
abilities.description: Deals Shadow/Fire damage to up to 4 targets.
abilities._source: CoA names Sunder as a Felfury spender in all three specs (Tyrant: 'Carve, Sargeron Smite, Sunder and Inner Demon are all you have to spend it on'; Burning Rage and Shadow Magi both modify it). target_type enemy_aoe, not is_aoe - see the _implementation_note on this file's doc.

abilities.name: Chaos Rush
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target. Generates 20 Felfury.
abilities._source: CoA: the class-tree dash - Legion March extends its range, Doomstride refreshes a charge, Felguard and Felstrider ride on it, Reachwalker and Scars of the Past key off it. A gap-closer that builds.

abilities.name: Inner Demon
abilities.description: Attack Power Pct +15%, Physical crit chance +8, Spell crit chance +8, Haste +10 for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'the Inner Demon window, the kit's periodic power state' - the Demon Form every spec builds riders onto. NOT effect_type shapeshift: combat/forms.py has no Felsworn form and FORMS is keyed by class, and shifting zeroes the current resource pool by design, which would empty the Felfury bar on entering the damage window. A plain self-buff instead. Free to cast so the window is never gated behind the resource it is meant to spend. || buff_scope set to 'combat', 6 Nov 2026. It was never stated, so it inherited the engine's 'raid' default (abilities.py:644), which sets real_time_seconds to 30 real MINUTES and makes tick_status_effects skip the effect - so THE `duration` FIELD WAS NEVER READ and this short cooldown was live for every fight in the next half hour. On this class that is not cosmetic: Demonic Will is -30% physical damage taken on a 10-turn cooldown and was permanently on, and Illidan's Guile states 1 turn on an 18-turn cooldown. These are Icy Veins / Evasion-family cooldowns, which is what 'combat' scope is for. Scoped to Felsworn deliberately because its Tyrant tree is being rebuilt around these buffs; 45 across 11 other classes still have the shape (tools/qa_buff_scope.py) and Kyle has parked that sweep.

abilities._source: CoA: 'Cripple slows movement and casting'. haste on a monster is read by TurnMeter.update via get_status_stat_mod, so this genuinely costs the target turns - the closest the engine has to a cast slow.

abilities.name: Consume Magic
abilities.description: Removes 1 magic effect from the target.
abilities._source: CoA class tree, Magic Fiend: 'Increases the amount of beneficial magic effects stolen by your Consume Magic by 1'. The steal is a dispel here; nothing in the engine moves a stolen buff onto the caster.

abilities.name: Felbreak
abilities.description: Interrupts and stuns the target for 1 turn.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Felbreak is a real interrupt on caster mobs, and that's your main group-facing contribution'. A turn engine has no cast bar to interrupt, so the honest equivalent is costing them the turn: is_stun with a 1-turn duration, which TurnMeter really does enforce. The school lockout rides along as a spell-hit debuff.

abilities.name: Sargeras Embrace
abilities.description: Deals Shadow damage to the target over time for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Channel a beam of fel magic upon an enemy, slowing your target's movement speed by 60% for 5.5 seconds and dealing Shadowflame Damage at the end of the duration'. Authored as a spell_dot: the engine has no channel, and a DoT is the closest thing to damage spread over a beam. The snare is lost - Cripple remains the real slow.

abilities.name: Infernal
abilities.description: Summons a pet to fight for you.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Drop an infernal from the sky with grotesque magic, dealing fire SP Fire damage to enemies in the radius, horrifying them for 4 seconds, and spawning an Infernal to fight by your side for 15 seconds.' NOW A REAL INFERNAL: this used to borrow voidwalker and summoned a pet named Voidwalker, a Warlock demon, on the reasoning that combat/pet_templates.py had no infernal. It has one now - a slow, heavy fire bruiser whose signature Immolation is real spell_damage/fire, matching CoA's own 'SP Fire damage'. Still only the pet survives: effect_type summon_pet does one thing, so the impact damage and the fear are lost.

abilities.name: Manafeed

abilities._source: CoA: 'Manafeed converts a target's burned mana into health for you, closer to a Drain Life than a real defensive', 'Manafeed is your only heal'. Monsters have no mana here, so the heal is unconditional rather than dead weight against a mana-less target - a deliberate divergence, because the alternative is a spec with no self-healing at all.

abilities.name: Fel Infusion
abilities.description: Physical crit chance +3, Spell crit chance +3 for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Increases critical strike chance of all party and raid members within 100 by 3%... In addition, increases your critical strike chance by 3%', and 'its real group contribution is the passive Fel Infusion party/raid crit buff'. Passive auras have no shape here, so it is a party-scoped cooldown. || target_type 'self' -> 'party', 6 Nov 2026. CoA writes this as a party aura ('3% increased critical strike chance to party and raid members. Does not stack with similar effects'). A TALENT EFFECT CAN NEVER REACH AN ALLY; a party-targeted ABILITY does, since abilities.py:2064 resolves 'party' to all living allies and degrades to the caster alone with no party context. Same call Kyle made for Guardian's four auras on 5 Nov 2026, applied to Reaper's two and Necromancer's three today. Felsworn's talents now shorten these auras' cooldowns instead of trying to be them.
